serviceObjectives.availability: Production >=99.9% during owner-approved business hours; business-hours definition remains VAL-002.
serviceObjectives.interactivePerformance: p95 <5 seconds under the approved representative load.
serviceObjectives.packPerformance: Typical due-diligence pack <=30 minutes after the typical-pack definition and representative load are approved.
serviceObjectives.support: 8x5 with named incident ownership; support window and critical criteria remain VAL-002.
serviceObjectives.claimBoundary: No runtime, SLA, performance, availability, RTO or RPO achievement is claimed by this design.

regionalDecision.pattern: Zonal primary plus warm recovery in two General Counsel/DPO/CISO-approved Azure regions; all AI deployments are regional.
regionalDecision.failClosed: No regional resource, replication rule, backup destination or quota request is created until both exact region names and evidence ID are supplied. Azure SQL requestedBackupStorageRedundancy has no production default and cannot use Geo or GeoZone without a later approved design proving the paired secondary is within the signed boundary.

resilienceByState.state: Case, policy, review and citation metadata
resilienceByState.productionDesign: Business Critical starting hypothesis, zone redundancy in primary/recovery, automated PITR/LTR backups with explicit requestedBackupStorageRedundancy, SQL failover group and restore verification
resilienceByState.rpoDesign: <=1h through continuous backups and tested failover
resilienceByState.regionalConstraint: Both exact region names must pass VAL-005 and service availability checks. Production backup redundancy has no default; Local or Zone is allowed after capability evidence, while Geo and GeoZone are denied because they use an implicit paired region. The selection applies to STR and LTR and changes affect future backups only.

resilienceByState.productionDesign: Separate ZRS accounts in each approved region, versioning, soft delete, integrity hashes and owner-approved object replication/recovery manifest
resilienceByState.regionalConstraint: Do not rely on implicit geo-pairing; destination must be the explicitly approved recovery region.
Never promote temporary work to record status.

resilienceByState.productionDesign: Primary three-replica/one-partition hypothesis plus recovery service rebuilt from replicated admitted evidence
resilienceByState.rtoDesign: Warm recovery index or prioritised rebuild within service RTO
resilienceByState.regionalConstraint: Exact Search availability/capacity must be verified in both approved regions.

resilienceByState.productionDesign: Premium namespaces in primary/recovery, zone support where available, sessions, duplicate detection, dead-letter queues and recovery alias/metadata pattern
resilienceByState.rpoDesign: <=1h target; source state supports safe replay
resilienceByState.regionalConstraint: Metadata failover does not guarantee message replication; recovery manifest reconciles work.

resilienceByState.service: SQL outbox plus immutable Blob Storage
resilienceByState.productionDesign: Transactional outbox, hash chain, frequent export, ZRS and WORM
resilienceByState.rpoDesign: <=1h; critical export lag alert materially lower than RPO
resilienceByState.regionalConstraint: Retention and recovery copy location require owners.

resilienceByState.productionDesign: Internal Audit-owned identity and WORM/legal hold
resilienceByState.rpoDesign: No delivery-owned recovery process can overwrite it
resilienceByState.regionalConstraint: Assurance owner approves replication and recovery.

resilienceByState.service: Azure Container Registry, App Configuration and IaC package
resilienceByState.productionDesign: Private Premium registry with approved-region geo-replication, immutable release tags, versioned configuration and reproducible Bicep
resilienceByState.rtoDesign: Activate warm recovery or redeploy from approved hash-bound package
resilienceByState.regionalConstraint: Registry/configuration replicas are limited to the signed region pair.

failureModes.failure: Policy service or evidence dependency unavailable
failureModes.behaviour: Deny admission, analysis, approval and transfer; retain idempotent work for bounded retry; alert owner.

failureModes.failure: Azure OpenAI or Document Intelligence unavailable
failureModes.behaviour: Interactive case/review remains available; new analysis pauses; no uncited fallback output.
Retrieval-dependent analysis pauses; direct governed evidence remains reviewable; no ungrounded generation.

failureModes.failure: Audit export lag or immutable store unavailable
failureModes.behaviour: Critical control alert; after configured grace threshold, block material state transitions.
No source replacement or stale-data concealment; expose source version and retry state.

Invoke the confirmed warm-recovery pattern only after AFF-4/5 implement it and an authorised recovery exercise validates dependencies; fail over private enterprise DNS, SQL, application and AI endpoints in the documented order.

telemetryContract.instrumentation: OpenTelemetry traces, structured application logs, Azure resource metrics and diagnostic settings into workspace-based Application Insights/Log Analytics.
prohibitedTelemetry: full personal identifier unless separately approved
telemetryContract.redaction: Allow-list fields at source; hash or tokenise actor and subject references where operationally sufficient.
telemetryContract.retention: Hot and archive retention are required owner parameters; no period is invented. Legal hold overrides lifecycle deletion.
telemetryContract.location: Workspace, archive, ingestion and support access must all use HD-003 approved locations and SR-007 identities.

assuranceVerdict.admission: Submission is accepted only after exact private Blob versions are pulled, verified/scanned and copied to WORM; 202 transport/submission is not acceptance.
assuranceVerdict.evaluation: Internal Audit policy/registries/suite/release/schema/limits are immutable inputs; static default and separately authorised isolated dynamic execution.
assuranceVerdict.failure: Identity/trust/object/copy/sandbox/policy/signing/store failure leaves non-final or INCONCLUSIVE/FAIL; never local PASS.
assuranceVerdict.recovery: Internal Audit validates WORM copies, SQL/outbox, trust registries, signed release/image and exact submission before resume.

analysisVectorization.failure: Any binding/provenance/injection/filter/revocation/schema/dimension/provider mismatch stops; no lower-control fallback, tool or partial promotion.
analysisVectorization.revocation: Revocation/licence expiry/content change denies affected chunks/runs and queues versioned known-good rebuild.
analysisVectorization.recovery: Validate hostile corpus, tenant/case filters, citations/provenance and atomically switch alias only after complete checks.

auditExport.ordering: One sender lease per tenant/case; strict sequence and receiver predecessor check. Gap/conflict/signature/schema/poison never advances continuity.
auditExport.retry: Bounded jittered retry; TTL must exceed grace plus maximum retry/reconciliation window; explicit message size, duplicate window and dead-letter-on-expiry.
auditExport.receipt: Role-separated reconciler validates Internal Audit trust/signature and exact event/body/stream before VERIFIED_CONTIGUOUS; database update alone cannot satisfy guard.
auditExport.recovery: Preserve outbox/DLQ/quarantine/WORM/receipts, replay by stream, validate both producer and receipt trust and obtain Internal Audit continuity evidence.

assuranceSupplyChain.repository: Internal Audit independently operates the source repository/equivalent boundary, audit export, access reviews and contribution intake. Delivery has candidate-contribution only.
assuranceSupplyChain.promotion: Merge, build, signing, ACR publication, DU-16 deployment and operations/rollback use distinct identities and independent approvals. Each stage verifies the immutable predecessor hash.
monitoring: cross-role token use or role self-grant
assuranceSupplyChain.failure: Stop promotion at first missing/mismatched link; preserve source, logs, provenance, images and deployment evidence. No stage may bypass or perform another stage.
assuranceSupplyChain.rollback: Internal Audit rollback identity selects only a prior approved signed release after independent approval. Preserve failed release and never rebuild/resign to disguise rollback.
assuranceSupplyChain.recovery: Restore repository audit/protection, provenance, ACR immutable digest and deployment evidence; verify end-to-end chain before operations reopen.

trustSnapshotHistory.creation: Create immutable purpose-specific TrustVerificationSnapshot for exact signedAt, include snapshot/hash in record preimage, sign, and store record/snapshot together in WORM.
trustSnapshotHistory.rotation: Planned key/policy/registry rotation retains old immutable snapshots and does not rewrite records.
trustSnapshotHistory.revocation: Revocation/compromise effective before or at signedAt invalidates. Known post-signing effective time uses immutable policy disposition. Unknown/ambiguous effective time becomes TRUST_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
trustSnapshotHistory.materialGate: TRUST_REVIEW_REQUIRED, missing/tampered snapshot, invalid historical signature or WORM recovery uncertainty blocks material transitions until Internal Audit disposition.
trustSnapshotHistory.disasterRecovery: Restore signed record and snapshot as one recovery unit; verify WORM version, hashes, signature, retention/legal hold and trust evidence before status recovery.
trustSnapshotHistory.rollback: Software/configuration rollback never rolls trust history backwards or replaces snapshot/registry evidence.

verificationAddendum.criterion: Purpose-specific signature/trust/token mapping, rotation/revocation/compromise and canonical hash vectors pass; all negative cases deny.
Same producer/run+manifest replays; different manifest conflicts; corrected run supersedes with new validationRunId; exact submission verdict read.
Private exact-version pull/copy succeeds; SSRF/SAS/redirect/public path/version swap/ETag/hash/size/type/scan failures deny.
Independent evaluation inputs and signed assurance release bind verdict; sandbox isolation/limits/default-static behaviour verified.
Governed analysis hashes/provenance/filter/injection/citation/no-tool controls pass; hostile and cross-boundary tests deny.
Evidence revocation triggers non-queryable affected data, known-good rebuild and validated atomic alias switch.
Signed audit event/message hash/position/predecessor verified; conflict/gap/schema/signature/poison never advances continuity.
Signed receipt exact binding and role separation required for transition guard; local row fabrication fails.
Message size/duplicate-window/TTL/grace/reconciliation/order relationships fail configuration when invalid.
Recovery preserves and reconciles immutable/outbox/DLQ/quarantine state under Internal Audit authority.
Dedicated repository boundary, no delivery write/admin, two-person merge/promotion and cross-stage identity denial tests pass; chain from accepted tree to exact DU-16 digest/configuration verifies.
Every signed envelope includes signedAt and a canonical WORM TrustVerificationSnapshot/hash; missing/mismatch, wrong purpose, invalid time, replaced registry and snapshot tamper deny.
Planned rotation, pre/post-signing revocation/compromise, unknown compromise time, WORM loss/recovery and rollback historical-verification fixtures produce the specified immutable disposition.
